title: 航空構造力学
subtitle: Mechanics of Aircraft Structure
keywords: Structural configuration 2.Thin-walled section bar 3.Buckling 4.Stiffened plate 5.Effective width
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) features of the aircraft structure (2) how to analyze the deformation and stress of bars with thin-walled cross section under torsional moment (3) how to analyze the buckling load of slender columns and flat plates (4) the concept of effective width in flat plates with stiffeners
advice: On the basis of Industrial Mechanics and Mechanics of Materials, students will learn how to analyze the deformation and stress of lightweight structural members of aircraft, such as thin-walled structural members and thin plates with stiffeners. We will cover the following materials: (1) Features of the aircraft structure (2) Torsion of bars with circular cross section (3) Torsion of bars with thin-walled cross section (4) Buckling of slender column and flat plate (5) Buckling and effective width of plate with stiffeners Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in Industrial Mechanics and Mechanics of Materials before taking this course.
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of industrial mechanics and mechanics of materials.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the features of aircraft structure
Be able to calculate torsional stiffness and shear stress of bars with circular cross sections
Be able to calculate torsional stiffness and shear stress of bars with thin-walled sections
Be able to calculate buckling load of slender columns and flat plates
Be able to understand the concept of effective width and calculate the effective width of plate with stiffeners

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain features of aircraft structure from the viewpoint of structural mechanics (2) Accurately calculate the torsional stiffness and the torsional stress of bars with circular cross section (3) Accurately calculate the torsional stiffness and the torsional stress of bars with thin-walled section (4) Calculate the buckling load of a slender column or flat plate under various constraint conditions (5) Fully understand the mechanics of aircraft structure and apply it to design of aircraft structure
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain some of the structural members that constitute the wing and fuselage of an aircraft (2) Calculate the torsional stiffness of bars with circular cross section (3) Calculate the torsional stiffness of bars with thin-walled section (4) Calculate the buckling load of a slender column under various constraint conditions (5) Explain the concept of effective width
